scope: SYNTHETIC DEMO ONLY — not for production use
description: Policy for card-not-present disputes where the cardholder claims physical goods were not received.

required_evidence.label: Purchase Invoice
required_evidence.description: Original invoice showing order ID, amount, item(s), and customer details

required_evidence.label: Carrier Tracking Record
required_evidence.description: Carrier-provided tracking showing shipment movement and delivery status

required_evidence.label: Proof of Delivery
required_evidence.description: Delivery confirmation with date, recipient name, or signature

required_evidence.label: Order Confirmation
required_evidence.description: System-generated order confirmation sent to customer

required_evidence.label: Customer Communication
required_evidence.description: Any emails or messages between merchant and customer

required_checks.description: Order ID on invoice must exactly match dispute order ID
Invoice amount must exactly match dispute amount (Decimal comparison)
Tracking ID on shipping label must match carrier tracking record
Delivery date must be before the dispute response deadline
Delivery date must be before the dispute was filed
Shipping address should match billing address or customer-provided address

economic_assumptions.note: These are synthetic demo assumptions, not calibrated probabilities
